data.title: 焰影苇草 · 展厅里的一句话
data.description: 展厅即将关门，她靠近一些，悄声问下次能不能再陪她来看这幅画，语尾带着一点期待。
data.action: 侧身靠近，低声说出邀请
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: As the museum galleries quiet down before evening closing, Reed turns from a framed classical canvas and leans toward the viewer with a hopeful, bashful smile. Soft directional spotlights trace the contours of the hall's marble pedestals and wooden flooring.
data.animaCaption: Leaning close amidst the dimming gallery spotlights, she whispers an invitation to return again together, her smile full of quiet warmth.
